title: Week 1 consolidation
topic: Missed topics drill — SCP, IAM roles, KMS, WAF scope, observability
format: 15 timed scenario questions (~24 min, ~96 sec each). Answer without peeking at night-7-quiz-answers.json first.
answerDistribution: A×4 B×3 C×4 D×4 — options shuffled so correct letter varies

questions.question: A developer with AdministratorAccess in a member account cannot launch RDS instances. IAM policies show Allow for rds:*. What is the most likely blocker?

options.A: An Organizations SCP explicitly denies rds:CreateDBInstance
options.B: CloudTrail is disabled in that Region
options.C: The VPC has no NAT Gateway
options.D: AWS Config is recording too many resources

questions.question: Account A wants Account B to attach a shared private subnet to a Transit Gateway. Which service enables the subnet share?
An ECS Fargate task cannot write logs to CloudWatch even though the task role has logs:CreateLogStream. What should you fix first?

options.A: Attach a WAF Web ACL to the task ENI
options.C: Move the task to a public subnet
options.D: Add CloudWatch Logs permissions to the task execution role

questions.question: Account B must read S3 objects encrypted with Account A's customer managed KMS key. Which combination is required?

options.A: S3 bucket policy on Account A only
options.B: KMS key policy on the CMK granting Account B + IAM policy on Account B principal
options.C: Secrets Manager rotation in Account A

questions.question: After enabling SSE-KMS on a bucket with millions of small GET requests, KMS costs spike. Which S3 feature reduces KMS API charges?
A team asks where to store a database password that must rotate automatically every 30 days. Best recommendation?
You need to enforce that all new S3 PutObject calls use SSE-KMS. Which control is most direct?

options.A: S3 bucket policy with s3:x-amz-server-side-encryption condition Deny
options.C: Attach Shield Advanced to the bucket

questions.question: You must attach a WAF Web ACL to a CloudFront distribution for globalskiatlas.com. In which Region and scope must you create the Web ACL?

options.A: Same Region as the S3 origin only — no special scope
options.B: Any Region; WAF is global for all scopes
options.C: eu-west-1 because CloudFront edge is in Europe

questions.question: You need WAF on an Application Load Balancer in eu-central-1. What scope and Region apply?
A CISO wants to deploy the same AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet WAF rules to 40 member accounts automatically. Best service?
An auditor needs cryptographic proof that CloudTrail log files were not modified after delivery to S3. Which feature?
You need continuous evaluation of whether any IAM user currently lacks MFA enabled. Best approach?

options.A: CloudWatch metric alarm on IAM API calls

questions.question: Security Hub shows GuardDuty and Inspector findings in one prioritized dashboard. A separate team wants org-wide WAF policy deployment. Which mapping is correct?

options.A: Security Hub deploys WAF; Firewall Manager aggregates findings
options.B: Both services deploy WAF Web ACLs
options.D: Security Hub aggregates findings; Firewall Manager deploys WAF policies org-wide

questions.question: An S3 bucket policy allows s3:GetObject to Principal "*". Which tool analyzes whether resources are accessible from outside your AWS account?
A startup needs automated multi-account landing zones with guardrails and account vending. Which service?
